authorityPolicy: CEFR describes proficiency and communicative ability; it does not officially assign one universal CEFR level to every individual word or construction.
CEFR-J, Oxford and other learner resources are curriculum evidence/cross-checks, not learner-state authority.
LINGUA_A0 is an internal Pre-A1 bootstrap band and must never be presented as an official CEFR-J lexical level.
Earlier-than-reference placements require explicit review; later-than-reference placements are conservative warnings rather than automatic blockers.
Part-of-speech and sense identity must be resolved before a lexical level comparison can be trusted.
Phrase, grammar and communicative-skill evidence are delegated to type-specific audits instead of being inferred from word-level evidence.
